name: Premier Anti-Aging Co.,Ltd.
summary: Premier Anti-Aging Co., Ltd. plans, develops, imports, exports, wholesales and retails recovery wear, cosmetics and health foods in Japan, including through mail order and e-commerce. It works in anti-aging and recovery businesses and makes products for skin, hair and inner care under brands such as DUO, CANADEL, Clayence and Lalaskin. Incorporated in 2009, it has its headquarters in Minato, Japan.
